user_observation: I do not think that hurt anything, but I am skeptical that it helped.

capture_cycle.recording_instruction: Record from HYBRID READER - COMPLETE REQUEST TIMING until the same heading returns; retain two more seconds. Stop once every page has appeared. Repeated pages are the same frozen data.

findings: Console boot and cache delivery are confirmed for this candidate.
Only 62 speculative 512-byte blocks were produced; the 384-block cache never reached full.
86 cache feed operations account for about 3.8 percent of measured demand feeds. Hits include reused raw-sector boundary and seed blocks, so they do not count unique speculative blocks.
Seven distinct requests received at least one cached block; this does not mean seven full requests were cache hits.
Eight abandonments with zero CRC, token, guard, clock, foreign or unrecovered-overrun errors need cause and call-site diagnostics. The current counters cannot identify their exact cause.

After abandonment, producer() returns before counting a producer visit until seed_completed() sees a new completed demand token. This can explain many heartbeat visits with little production, but the exact initiating failures are not captured.
The longest whole request remains about139ms versus about143ms previously; different sectors and capture phase prevent a controlled speedup claim.
The requested90seconds includes repeated pages; one complete cycle is sufficient.
limits: The video shows frozen diagnostic pages, not synchronized game rendering.
The current sample has8requests/492sectors; the previous sample had7requests/419sectors and a different LBA range.
MISS VISITS counts delivery visits with zero cache feeds, not missing blocks.
IRQ ENTRIES and IRQ BLOCKS include demand work; they do not establish idle read-ahead throughput.
MAX AUX VISIT includes demand fallback; it is not a pure speculative-work budget or a rendered-frame duration.
Zero guard counters do not establish broad game compatibility.
Cache-hit counts include seed blocks already read on demand and retained raw boundary blocks; they do not count card reads avoided. Capture start resets counters but preserves warm cached data.

next_diagnostic.target: Identify the producer abandonment stage and exact return code before changing cache size, priority or batch pacing.
hypotheses: Transport RESET during receive/handoff or DMA restart.
Cache APPEND rejecting validity or LBA continuity.
next_diagnostic.not_proven: The cause of the eight abandonments is not recorded; do not select a cause or clear the latch blindly.
